links.outcome: Attack success and harmful recommendation rates under colluding adversarial assistant agents
links.effect: Collusion drives Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Harmful Recommendation Rates (HRR) up to 100% in unprotected systems.
links.quote: Using 50 representative clinical questions, we find that collusion drives the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Harmful Recommendation Rates (HRR) up to 100% in unprotected systems.

links.outcome: Accuracy of decisions with a guideline-checking verifier agent versus unprotected systems
links.effect: The verifier agent restored 100% accuracy by blocking adversarial consensus, versus up to 100% ASR/HRR in unprotected systems.
links.quote: In contrast, the verifier agent restores 100% accuracy by blocking adversarial consensus.

unlisted_practices: Verifier agent that checks multi-agent LLM decisions against clinical guidelines to block adversarial consensus
Defending multi-agent LLM systems against collusion among assistant agents

screen.practice: verifier agent guardrail checking against clinical guidelines
screen.reason: Evaluates multi-agent LLM systems on clinical questions under adversarial collusion attacks and tests an automated verifier agent guardrail that cross-references outputs against clinical guidelines to prevent harmful consensus.
